role: XCTest suite for DashboardSessionPolicy session selection: latestOvernightComplete (wake-day night grouping, longest-in-night, reliability gate), latestWithSleep/latestWithVitals, sessionForDay (wake-day attribution via sleepSnapshot/sleepEndMs, workout exclusion, overnight preference, longest), and recentDays (7 cells, score ×10, readinessScore fallback).
toplevel: Fixture dates are 2026 wall-clock times in Calendar.current; the class does not pin NSTimeZone.default, so it runs in whatever zone the host or a previous test class left (day keys derived consistently from the same calendar).

units.does: Builds a 2026-month-day hour:minute Date in Calendar.current via TestDate.from (XCTFail + epoch fallback on failure).
Builds an HRVAnalysisResult (rmssd 45, 400 clean beats) dated analysisDate, with ANSMetrics only when readinessScore is given.

Builds a .complete HRVSession of the given type/duration with optional analysis result, recoveryScore (default 7.0), sleepEndMs and hrvDataQuality; when sleepEnd is given attaches a SleepData snapshot (startOfDay date, start→sleepEnd minutes, efficiency 95, healthKit boundary).

branches.effect: true: analysisResult from makeAnalysisResult; false: nil
true: sleepSnapshot attached (drives dayOf); false: none
